name: Pan-Fried Chicken Breasts with Corn, Tomato & Feta Salad

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ears corn
1 small pkg grape tomatoes
½ lime
½ small bunch green onions (scallions)

instructions.primary_message: Remove the husks and silks from the corn. Working one ear at a time, hold the corn vertically inside a large bowl and slice the kernels away from the cob; discard the cob. Set the bowl aside.
Halve the grape tomatoes crosswise and transfer to a medium salad bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the green onions; cut the onions crosswise into 6-mm pieces at an angle. Add to the salad bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

While the skillet heats up, pat the chicken dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets. Season the cutlets with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
0.34 kg chicken breasts, boneless skinless
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Place the chicken cutlets in the skillet; cook until they are golden brown on the outside and cooked through in the center, 2 to 4 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm. Cook in batches if necessary.
Once the chicken has been transferred, add the corn kernels to the skillet; cook, stirring frequently, until tender and lightly browned, 3 to 4 minutes. Once done, add to the salad bowl.
Add the feta to the salad bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: ½ (113 g) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.primary_message: Juice the lime and add to the salad bowl.
Drizzle the salad with olive oil and season with salt and pepper; toss to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide the chicken cutlets and salad between plates; season the salad with additional salt and pepper if desired. Enjoy!
